## 7.0 Moderation & Mediation

*"... there will be a time when we must choose between what is easy and what is right"*

- The famous statistician Albus Dumbledore---presumably commenting on moderation and mediation in nonlinear models

![](images/dumbledore-1.jpeg){width=38% fig-alt="Albus Dumbledore, an old wizard with a long white beard, from the Harry Potter films."} ![](images/dumbledore-2.jpeg){width=50% fig-alt="Albus Dumbledore raising a finger as he speaks, beside lit candles."}

## Overview of topics

1. **Nonlinear interaction effects** (AKA statistical moderation)
   - Best practices for testing interaction effects using predicted probabilities and marginal effects
     - Interaction effects can be classified based on the measurement level of the IVs involved in the interaction:
       1. Nominal X Continuous interactions
       2. Nominal X Nominal interactions
       3. Continuous X Continuous interactions
2. **Cross-model comparisons** (e.g., mediation) and the problem of comparing effects across nonlinear models
   - Identification issues of coefficients
     - Model rescaling
     - Solutions to the rescaling problem
   - Comparisons of predicted probabilities and marginal effects
